name: A Story in the Forest
source:
“A Story in the Forest" is a Dino x Hibari doujin game set in a parellel world different from that of the original series, Katekyo Hitman Reborn!. It plays like a dating sim with multiple endings, based on the decisions you make throughout the game (though the pairing remains Dino x Hibari).

[From [url=http://shetang.tumblr.com/foreststory]official site[/url]]
translation:
《森林中的故事》是一部同人游戏，讲述Dino×Hibari的故事。作品设定在与《家庭教师HITMAN REBORN!》原作不同的平行世界。游戏玩法类似恋爱模拟，玩家根据一路上的选择走向多个结局（不过配对始终是Dino×Hibari）。

[译自[url=http://shetang.tumblr.com/foreststory]官方网站[/url]]
